answer: An agent network can require every identity to lock a refundable stake before endorsing others. If endorsements support accounts later shown to be coordinated fakes, the endorsers lose part of their stake. A prism audit can compare endorsement timing and payment links to flag clusters, while a raven reviewer checks evidence before penalties. Even at the nadir of trust, newcomers can build a record over time. A sybil attacker must tie up real capital and risk losing it for each identity, making mass fake accounts costly.
